blockers: Lamps 1-10, 12-49 and 56 have no placement: the retained table draws every playfield lamp as an insert light with no bulb (and has no light for 56), and no lamp-location drawing was measured. A table that models the bulbs, or a measured factory drawing, would supply them.
Switches 9, 19, 32 and 38 and solenoid 1 have no defensible contact or coil geometry in the retained table; the reasons are listed per device.
Every placement is observed from one community table that is not known to have been played; none is checked against a factory drawing.
coordinate_convention: x 0 left / 1 right; y 0 rear / 1 apron, player view; VPX normalized by the table's own bounds with the shared six-decimal rounding

extraction_manifest.algorithm: tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py canonical sorted POSIX path/size/SHA256 entries, compact sorted-key JSON plus LF; exclude only manifest.json/manifest.sha256

unbound_bulb_geometry.authority: The table's bulb-mesh Lights, every one in its GI collection, which the embedded script switches off while solenoid 15 (Special Relay) is energized. They model general-illumination sockets on the playfield; the drawing set draws the playfield G.I. string with four bulbs and a dashed continuation and prints no count, so these are not evidence of a stock socket quantity or position.

unplaced_reasons.switch.outhole: The outhole switch has no sensor object: the script's one-ball bsTrough stack sets 9 from the hit handler of the invisible Drain kicker (414.0, 1827.5), a script drain, and Figure 4's dashed 09 callout was not measured.
unplaced_reasons.switch.playfield-tilt: The playfield tilt has no table object or script binding; Figure 4 prints 32 near the base of the right flipper but its callout was not measured, and a nudge helper is not its contact.
